description: Unit test class for ImmutableFeatureDefinition and its builder, testing immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, builder operations, and exception handling.

classes.name: ImmutableFeatureDefinitionTest
classes.description: Test suite for ImmutableFeatureDefinition class, verifying core functionalities like immutability, equality, JSON conversion, and builder operations.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that ImmutableFeatureDefinition is immutable and that DefinitionIdentifier is also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of equals and hashCode methods in ImmutableFeatureDefinition.

methods.name: tryToGetBuilderWithNullIdentifier
methods.description: Ensures that passing null to getBuilder throws NullPointerException with appropriate message.

methods.name: getFirstIdentifierFromBuilderReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the builder correctly stores and returns the first identifier.

methods.name: getSizeFromBuilderReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the builder reports correct size after initialization.

methods.name: addIdentifierToBuilderWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Tests adding a single identifier to the builder.

methods.name: addAllToBuilderWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Tests adding multiple identifiers to the builder via addAll.

methods.name: removeIdentifierFromBuilderWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Tests removing an identifier from the builder.

methods.name: tryToBuildFeatureDefinitionWithEmptyBuilder
methods.description: Ensures building with an empty builder throws IndexOutOfBoundsException.

methods.name: getFirstIdentifierReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the final built object returns the correct first identifier.

methods.name: getSizeReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the built object reports the correct number of identifiers.

methods.name: valuesAreInExpectedOrder
methods.description: Ensures the order of identifiers in the built object matches the insertion order.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies JSON serialization output matches expected JSON.

methods.name: fromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests deserialization from JSON to ImmutableFeatureDefinition.

methods.name: fromJsonOfEmptyArrayFailsWithException
methods.description: Checks that deserializing an empty JSON array throws FeatureDefinitionEmptyException.
